lines.speaker: Traveling Merchant
lines.text: Hail, travelers! I've got wares if you've got coin. Some fresh supplies, perhaps?

lines.speaker: Traveling Merchant
lines.text: Three days' rations, packed and ready. You won't regret it on the long road ahead.

lines.speaker: Traveling Merchant
lines.text: Watch yourself out there. I saw brigands camped near the southern crossroads. Nasty lot.

lines.speaker: Traveling Merchant
lines.text: Suit yourself. The road is long and lonely — may fortune favor you.
